prefix_cache_long_repeat.description: Repeated long prompts to quantify warm Prefix Cache TTFT reduction on the same request set after warmup.
prompts: Please analyze a continuous batching inference engine for a small Qwen2 model running on a laptop GPU. Explain the responsibilities of request admission, prompt prefill, paged KV allocation, block-table construction, slot mapping, decode scheduling, token sampling, and completion handling. Then discuss how Prefix Cache reuse, FP8 KV storage, cublasLt fast paths, stream synchronization, and decode-heavy scheduling each affect latency, throughput, and memory pressure. Finally, list three likely bottlenecks and three concrete optimization ideas, each with a short technical justification.
